item.title: Abbott: It’s OK for Texans to bring guns to protests
item.description: Gov. Greg Abbott stood his ground Thursday in support of Texans’ constitutional right to carry guns to protests, countering fellow Republicans who say demonstrators can’t — or at least shouldn’t — have weapons at those events.
